title: 3 Google AI updates: Hydrogen, Android, Tabletop #shorts
description:
3 Google AI updates in 40 seconds.

1. Gemini 4 Hydrogen ab Google Search me hai: Google ke hisaab se Search ka ab tak ka sabse bada model upgrade, aur ye globally sab users ke liye available hai.
2. Android par Gemini Intelligence ke naye features: Rambler bole hue vichar ko saaf text me badalta hai (Pixel 10 family aur motorola signature 27), aur task automation UK, India aur Japan me expand ho raha hai (Gemini app, 18+).
3. Tabletop, Google Labs ka naya experiment: group ke liye trip itinerary, dinner poll, expense splitter aur tournament bracket. Abhi sirf US (18+), waitlist se.

Sources (official pages):
https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/gemini-4-hydrogen-search-upgrade/
https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/gemini-intelligence-november-features-devices/
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-labs/tabletop/

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Google.

Note: page crops are our own capture of the official pages (key lines highlighted). Photos are free AI-generated illustrations, not real product shots. Synthetic voice.
